author: More Perfect Union
description:
Elon Musk wants a SpaceX IPO valuing the company at upwards of $1.75 trillion.

To get there, he got the rules changed so that index funds, with millions of Americans' retirement savings, are forced to buy in.

Retirees could take huge losses, while insiders cash out.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
When an anonymous tech giant got St. Charles to sign NDAs to ram through a data center, the Missouri city rose up to beat the project back.

Now the city, not half an hour from St. Louis, has enacted the first indefinite data center ban in the country.

Here's how they did it.

Host/Co-producer: @danliebs
Co-producer: Court Fuller
Editor: Kenneth Kerr
title: This Missouri Town Kicked Data Centers Out For Good
